cards.ex: We need an honest broker to mediate this dispute and find a solution that works for everyone.
cards.exUz: Bizga bu bahsni hal qilish va har kimga mos keladigan yechimni topish uchun xolis vositachi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Tortishayotgan tomonlar o'rtasida adolatli va betaraf vositachilik qiluvchi shaxs.

cards.ex: I assure you, this business is completely on the up-and-up; we have nothing to hide.
cards.exUz: Ishonch bilan ayta olamanki, bu biznes butunlay halol; biz yashiradigan hech narsamiz yo'q.
cards.uzDef: Halol, qonuniy va shaffof tarzda ish yuritish yoki harakat qilish.

cards.ex: She told a little fib about her age to get a discount.
cards.exUz: U chegirma olish uchun yoshi haqida kichik yolg'on gapirdi.
cards.uzDef: Uncha katta bo'lmagan, zarar keltirmaydigan yolg'on.

cards.ex: I just had to take his word for it; I had no other way to verify the information.
cards.exUz: Men uning so'ziga ishonishim kerak edi; ma'lumotni tekshirishning boshqa yo'li yo'q edi.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishining aytganiga shubhasiz ishonish.

cards.ex: We need to clear the air after that argument; it's causing tension.
cards.exUz: O'sha janjaldan keyin biz tushunmovchilikni bartaraf etishimiz kerak; bu keskinlikni keltirib chiqarmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Tushunmovchilikni bartaraf etish va vaziyatni yaxshilash.

cards.ex: His explanation didn't quite ring true to me; I felt like he was holding something back.
cards.exUz: Uning izohi menga unchalik haqiqatga o'xshamadi; Men u nimadir yashirayotgandek his qildim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqiqiy va ishonchli bo'lib tuyulishi.

cards.ex: He told us a tall tale about fighting off a bear with his bare hands.
cards.exUz: U bizga ayiqni qo'llari bilan urushib haydab chiqargani haqida afsonaviy hikoya aytib berdi.
cards.uzDef: Haqiqatga to'g'ri kelmaydigan, juda g'alati va ishonish qiyin bo'lgan hikoya.

cards.ex: She was laying it on thick with the compliments, hoping to get a better grade.
cards.exUz: U yaxshiroq baho olish umidida maqtovlarni haddan tashqari mubolag'a qildi.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsani juda kuchaytirib yoki mubolag'a qilib aytish.

cards.ex: After realizing his mistake, he offered a sincere apology.
cards.exUz: Xatosini anglab yetgach, u chin dildan uzr so'radi.
cards.uzDef: Chin ko'ngildan qilingan, afsuslanishni ifodalovchi uzr so'rash.

cards.ex: Before you start spreading rumors, get your facts straight!
cards.exUz: Mish-mishlarni tarqatishdan oldin, aniq dalillarga ega bo'ling!
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida gapirishdan oldin, to'g'ri va aniq ma'lumotga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: He was leading her on, even though he had no intention of dating her seriously.
cards.exUz: U qizga jiddiy munosabatda bo'lish niyati bo'lmasa ham, uni aldab umidlantirardi.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishiga noto'g'ri umid berib, aldash.

cards.ex: She suddenly came out with the truth during the argument.
cards.exUz: U janjal paytida to'satdan haqiqatni aytib yubordi.
cards.uzDef: Kutilmaganda biror sirni yoki fikrni aytib yuborish.

cards.ex: We need to hold the company accountable for the environmental damage they caused.
cards.exUz: Biz kompaniyani atrof-muhitga yetkazgan zarari uchun javobgarlikka tortishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishini o'z harakatlari uchun javobgar qilish.

cards.ex: It was a barefaced lie, and everyone knew it.
cards.exUz: Bu ochiq yolg'on edi va hamma buni bilardi.
cards.uzDef: Ochiqchasiga va bemalol aytilgan yolg'on.

cards.ex: Telling the truth was a no-brainer; lying would have made things worse.
cards.exUz: Haqiqatni aytish oson qaror edi; yolg'on vaziyatni yomonlashtirardi.
cards.uzDef: Shubhasiz, aniq va oson bo'lgan qaror.

cards.ex: I appreciate that he's always on the level with me, even when it's hard.
cards.exUz: Men uni qadrlayman, u hatto qiyin bo'lsa ham, doimo menga rostgo'y.
cards.uzDef: Halol, rostgo'y va ishonchli bo'lmoq.

cards.ex: It's better to fess up now than to try and cover it up later.
cards.exUz: Buni keyin yashirishga urinishdan ko'ra, hozir tan olgan yaxshiroq.
cards.uzDef: Xatoni yoki jinoyatni tan olmoq.

cards.ex: I decided to tell her the truth, because honesty is the best policy.
cards.exUz: Men unga haqiqatni aytishga qaror qildim, chunki rostgo'ylik eng yaxshi siyosatdir.
cards.uzDef: Doimo rost gapirish eng yaxshi yo'l ekanligini ifodalovchi maqol.

cards.ex: I promised to keep mum about their secret.
cards.exUz: Men ularning sirini hech kimga aytmaslikka va'da berdim.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsa haqida jim turish, hech kimga aytmaslik.

cards.ex: He's always spinning yarns about his adventures.
cards.exUz: U doimo o'zining sarguzashtlari haqida hikoyalar to'qiydi.
cards.uzDef: Qiziqarli, ammo haqiqatga to'g'ri kelmaydigan hikoya to'qish.

cards.ex: The accountant was arrested for cooking the books.
cards.exUz: Buxgalter moliyaviy hisobotlarni soxtalashtirgani uchun hibsga olindi.
cards.uzDef: Kompaniyaning moliyaviy hisobotlarini qonunga xilof ravishda o'zgartirish.

cards.ex: There's probably a grain of truth in what he said, but I doubt it's the whole story.
cards.exUz: Uning aytganlarida haqiqat ulishi bo'lishi mumkin, lekin bu to'liq hikoya ekanligiga shubha qilaman.
cards.uzDef: Biror narsada ozgina bo'lsa ham haqiqat mavjudligi.

cards.ex: We negotiated the deal in good faith, hoping for a positive outcome.
cards.exUz: Biz ijobiy natijaga umid qilib, bitim bo'yicha sof niyat bilan muzokara olib bordik.
cards.uzDef: Halol va to'g'ri niyat bilan harakat qilish.

cards.ex: I'm going to level with you: I don't think you're ready for this job.
cards.exUz: Men sizga rostini aytmoqchiman: men siz bu ishga tayyor emassiz deb o'ylayman.
cards.uzDef: Biror kishiga to'g'risini va ochiqchasiga aytish.

cards.ex: I give you my word, on my honor, that I will not betray you.
cards.exUz: Sizga so'z beraman, sharafimga qasamki, men sizga xiyonat qilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Shaxsiy sharafiga qasam ichib biror narsaga kafolat berish.

cards.ex: It was an outright lie, and he knew he was being dishonest.
cards.exUz: Bu butunlay yolg'on edi va u nosamimiy bo'layotganini bilar edi.
cards.uzDef: Ochiqchasiga va to'liq yolg'on.

cards.ex: Don't try to hide it; the truth will out eventually.
cards.exUz: Uni yashirishga urinmang; haqiqat oxir-oqibat yuzaga chiqadi.
cards.uzDef: Oxir-oqibat haqiqat oshkor bo'lishi haqidagi maqol.

cards.ex: The treasurer needs to be above suspicion to maintain trust.
cards.exUz: G'aznachi ishonchni saqlab qolish uchun shubhaga o'rin qoldirmasligi kerak.
cards.uzDef: Shubha uyg'otmaydigan darajada halol va to'g'ri.

cards.ex: Stop passing the buck and take responsibility for your actions!
cards.exUz: Javobgarlikdan qochishni to'xtating va o'z harakatlaringiz uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmangizga oling!
cards.uzDef: Javobgarlikni boshqa bir kishiga yuklash.

cards.ex: Can you just give me a straight answer? Yes or no?
cards.exUz: Shunchaki aniq javob bera olasizmi? Ha yoki yo'q?
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri va aniq javob bermoq, qochirmasdan.
